models.model_description: Nano Banana 2 is a high-efficiency image generation and conversational image editing model built for fast, large-scale visual creation. It combines the intelligence of the Gemini 3 series with low latency, strong instruction following, and production-oriented image quality, making it well suited for high-volume creative workflows such as marketing assets, product mockups, storyboards, infographics, and iterative visual editing. It supports conversational multimodal workflows with text and image inputs, and is positioned as the faster, more scalable counterpart to Gemini 3 Pro Image.
